title: Solution Engineering (Early in Profession)- Copilot & Agents

Connect technical work to measurable outcomes, including productivity, employee experience, process improvement, risk reduction and time to value. Invest in continuous learning, share reusable demonstrations and agent patterns, and contribute to the wider Solution Engineering community. Experience explaining technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences through presentations, demonstrations or workshops. Ability to learn quickly, work across teams, manage competing priorities and follow through on commitments. Experience building prototypes, copilots, agents, workflows, applications or integrations using low-code or pro-code tools. Understanding of prompt design, agent grounding, connectors and actions, orchestration, testing, evaluation and responsible AI practices. Familiarity with enterprise security, compliance, data governance, adoption or change-management requirements. Relevant Microsoft fundamentals, Power Platform, Copilot or Azure certifications. title: Product Manager, Agentic Safety
description: About Mistral Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. The Role Mistral AI provides full-stack AI solutions, from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute, used by developers, enterprises, and public institutions worldwide. We are a dynamic, creative, low-ego team distributed across Europe, North America, Asia, and the Middle East, passionate about AI's potential to transform society. As our models and products reach millions of people and power increasingly critical workloads across enterprises and public institutions, safety is becoming an essential product challenge. We are looking for our first Product Manager, Agentic Safety to own this space end-to-end, translating safety research and policy into concrete, user-facing product behaviors across our API platform and product surfaces. You will define which guardrails should be enabled by default, what controls customers should have, and how we measure and communicate residual risk. Working at the intersection of Product, Research, Engineering, Policy, Legal, and Security, you will shape how safety is built into our products, balancing protection, usability, and customer needs. This is a unique opportunity to build a new product function from the ground up and directly influence how frontier AI is deployed responsibly at scale. What You Will Do Safety Product Strategy Own the Safety roadmap across Mistral's API platform and products, including Vibe and Studio, from strategy through to product behavior and delivery. Define the product vision and priorities for safety features, guardrails, controls, and safeguards. Translate safety research and policy requirements into practical product capabilities that customers can understand, configure, and trust. Determine which safety mechanisms should be enabled by default and where customers should have flexibility and control. Safety Measurement and Evaluation Define how safety is measured across our products, including evaluations, residual risk, precision and coverage trade-offs, and emerging harm trends. Establish clear metrics and take accountability for tracking and improving safety performance. Work closely with Research and Engineering teams to translate evaluation results into actionable product improvements. Ensure safety considerations are embedded in feature launches and deployment decisions through a safety-by-design approach. Incident Management and Continuous Improvement Lead Safety incident response and post-incident reviews. Turn safety events, emerging risks, and customer feedback into concrete product improvements. Establish processes to identify, assess, and mitigate safety risks across our products. Continuously assess the effectiveness of existing safeguards and identify opportunities to strengthen them. Cross-Functional Leadership and External Representation Partner closely with Policy, Legal, Research, Engineering, Security, and Operations to drive safety initiatives across the organization. Align and mobilize cross-functional teams to deliver safety improvements without compromising product velocity or customer trust. Represent Mistral on Safety product topics in discussions with customers and regulators. Communicate complex safety decisions, trade-offs, and residual risks clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. What We're Looking For Several years of experience in Product Management, with meaningful exposure to Safety, platform integrity, abuse prevention, or AI safety. Strong technical understanding of LLM guardrails, safety evaluations, and red-teaming, with the ability to discuss thresholds, methodologies, and trade-offs with researchers and engineers. Strong product judgment when navigating ambiguous trade-offs between safety and freedom of expression, as well as safety and product utility. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex decisions and articulate the rationale behind product choices. Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives, align stakeholders, and inspire teams without direct authority. Comfort operating in ambiguous environments and building from zero, with the ability to define a new function rather than simply maintain an existing product line. Experience working at an AI lab or frontier-model company is a plus. Exposure to AI regulation and compliance frameworks, particularly the EU AI Act, is a plus. An engineering or research background is a plus. You don't necessarily check every box above but are genuinely driven by the mission of making frontier AI safe and trustworthy for the people and organizations who rely on it. What We Offer We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page . Privacy Policy Your privacy matters to us. title: Sezzle: Customer Service Agent

We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping! Are you passionate about driving customer success? Addicted to solving problems? So are we. We are looking for a customer-driven problem solver at Sezzle. With a fun, genuine, and empathetic voice, you will be troubleshooting and writing clear and concise instructions to solve questions about utilizing Sezzle. You have excellent written and verbal communication skills. You are dependable, resourceful, and get joy from going beyond to make customers successful. What You'll Do: Provide clear, prompt, detailed, empathetic, and customer-oriented support to our consumers Showcase passion and connection with the nooks and crannies product  Assist customers to resolve basic to complex inquiries via email, live chat, and phone call Build a network of support and trust with our awesome customer support team! Work with customers to understand how they use Sezzle services, and provide valuable feedback to Product and Development teams Act as an advocate for our customers, report and act on observed areas for improvement in our product or processes Actively seek solutions to customer needs, communicate trends to leadership, and suggest innovative solutions on behalf of the customer - experience What We Look For: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills Fluent in written and spoken English Proven success in a fast-paced support environment Exceptional verbal and written communication skills to provide clear, articulate and kind customer support in technical instructions via phone support, email, and live chat Able to efficiently manage multiple tasks at the same time and utilize personal judgment to take initiative Driven to dig into the details of a system or process to solve customer problems Displays a passion for what you do while upholding personal and corporate integrity Excitement to learn new technologies and help customers succeed 3+ years of customer support experience Email, phone and/or live chat experience dealing with complex issues, troubleshooting, and problem resolution, preferably with software Fluent in written and spoken English and Spanish (a third language is a pre) Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education and experience Zendesk, LiveAgent or Jira experience is a plus Work Conditions Remote, work-from-home Must work from Bogotá, Colombia, can't work outside of the country.  3-4 training weeks Full availability first 2 months, no vacations could be approved in this period Fixed shift, based in Central Standard Time Competitive salary, bonus structure   Compensation and Benefits Salary: $3.000.000 COP monthly Benefits: Remote role About You: You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed. You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking. You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully. You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly. You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle. What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome: At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.  #Li-remote #full-time   To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/sezzle-customer-service-agent

title: AI Fabric Architect
description: fal is the generative media ecosystem powering the next generation of AI products. We build the infrastructure, tools, and model access that teams need to move from idea to production, and do it at scale without compromise. For developers and enterprises, fal is the foundation that makes generative media not just possible, but practical: a unified platform where high-performance inference, orchestration, and observability come together to unlock new categories of AI-native products. As generative media reshapes industries across a market projected to grow by hundreds of billions over the next decade, fal is becoming the ecosystem that ambitious teams build on. About this role You are the architect of the network that our GPU clusters run on. You own the fabric end to end, from the NIC in each GPU server through the spine and leaf across the AI fabric, and you know that in AI infrastructure the network is core to the machine. As fal brings its own GPU capacity online across multiple sites, you will define the fabric architecture every site is built from, and then personally make sure it gets built and performs. This is not an architecture-only role. We are a small team moving fast, and the right person is as comfortable writing a port map, tracing a bad optic, or tuning congestion control on the data center floor as they are setting technical direction. What you will do: Own the fabric architecture for every site: GPU backend fabric (InfiniBand and/or RoCEv2), and GPU frontend Fabric Choose topologies and make the key calls: rail-optimized vs. other designs, InfiniBand vs. Ethernet, oversubscription ratios, and how the fabric scales from one pod to many Turn the architecture into a repeatable network blueprint: cabling plans, port maps, fabric addressing and routing design, and a fabric bill of materials (switches, NICs, optics, cables) Get hands-on with bring-up at each site: be on the floor for the first racks, validate cabling and firmware, configure the fabric manager and switches, and run performance acceptance (NCCL tests, burn-in) before capacity goes live Tune for real workload performance: congestion control, PFC/ECN, adaptive routing, and NCCL settings for both inference and training traffic Debug fabric problems wherever they show up, from a flapping link to a job that’s mysteriously slow Evaluate and select AI Fabric vendors and hardware, and push back with data when something doesn’t meet spec Collaborate across automation and software to help build network monitoring, telemetry, and automation that let a small team run a large fleet, and be the top escalation point for AI Fabric incidents Document as you go so each new site is faster than the last, and help hire and mentor the network engineers who join after you Qualifications: 7+ years in data center or HPC networking, including direct responsibility for production GPU cluster fabrics A track record of taking GPU fabrics from empty racks to production, with your own hands on the work, not only through vendors or integrators Deep expertise in InfiniBand (NDR/XDR, UFM, subnet management) and/or RoCEv2 lossless Ethernet Strong command of rail-optimized and Clos/fat-tree designs, BGP/ECMP, and EVPN/VXLAN A clear understanding of how fabric design and tuning affect collective communication and real workload performance Comfortable automating with Python, Ansible, or similar Strong Linux skills and the ability to debug across the boundary between host, NIC, and fabric Sound judgment on tradeoffs between cost, performance, reliability, and time to deploy NVIDIA Quantum/Spectrum-X, ConnectX-7/8, BlueField-3 SuperNICs, and/or Broadcom Tomahawk 5-class Ethernet 400G/800G OSFP optics, AOC/DAC, MPO trunking Nice to have: Experience at a neocloud, hyperscaler AI infrastructure team, NVIDIA networking, or an AI factory integrator Experience with NVLink / NVL72-class rack-scale systems and how they change scale-out fabric design Experience with GPUDirect RDMA and GPUDirect Storage networks Experience building out multiple sites in parallel or on aggressive timelines Willingness to travel frequently to data center sites, especially during build-outs What we offer at fal: Interesting and challenging work Competitive salary and equity A lot of learning and growth opportunities We offer relocation
